# RULE-SET: Authorized tailnet peers and private names.
# Rules omit the policy field; DNS mappings only use domain entries.
# Bind this set to the tailscale policy in the consuming profile, placed after
# the LAN set and before FINAL. Do not bind it to REJECT: an empty or
# mis-bound set silently drops every tailnet destination.

# Group: Tailscale CGNAT range (node addresses, service VIPs, MagicDNS resolver)
IP-CIDR,100.64.0.0/10,no-resolve

# Group: Tailscale IPv6 prefix
# Add IP-CIDR6,fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48,no-resolve only where the profile routes
# IPv6; leaving it out keeps IPv6 from being captured by this policy.
